headline: Intuit Agrees to Sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 Billion
summary: Intuit has agreed to sell email marketing platform Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for roughly $3.68 billion, five years after buying it for $12 billion. Intuit shares fell 13% after hours.
why: Intuit is a leading American financial software corporation, and the sale marks a significant haircut on its largest acquisition to date.

impacts.name: Intuit Inc.
impacts.why: Shares dropped 13% in extended trading following the steep write-down on the $3.68 billion divestment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Intuit shares tumbled after reporting the sale of Mailchimp for less than a third of its original $12 billion acquisition price.
